description.zh:
群组状态。取值：

- ACTIVE：使用中。

- INACTIVE：未激活。

- SUSPENDED：已暂停。

- CREATING：创建中。

- DELETING：删除中。

- UPDATING：更新中。
description.en:
The group status. Valid values:

- ACTIVE: In use.

- INACTIVE: Not activated.

- SUSPENDED: Suspended.

- CREATING: Being created.

- DELETING: Being deleted.

- UPDATING: Being updated.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API获取IM群列表功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有创建成功的IM群。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，暂仅支持通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)接口创建IM群。

- 此接口的非必填参数为IM群列表的筛选条件，若不填写，则查询全部IM群列表。
descriptions.en:
><notice>The feature of retrieving IM group lists through API is a Meta beta feature. Contact your account manager to apply for access.></notice>

- Before calling this operation, make sure you have successfully created IM groups.

- If you do not have any created IM groups, you can only create IM groups through the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) operation.

- The optional parameters of this operation are filter conditions for the IM group list. If you do not specify them, all IM groups are returned.
